task1: conventional gland-forming adenocarcinoma architecture, relatively cohesive tumor regions, moderate desmoplastic stromal reaction, variable infiltrative tumor borders, limited mucinous or medullary-like areas, and less prominent lymphoid aggregation at the invasive margin.
task2: relatively organized glandular tumor regions, conventional adenocarcinoma growth patterns, moderate architectural distortion, variable stromal desmoplasia, less extensive mucinous differentiation, and tumor margins showing expansile or moderately infiltrative growth.
task3: conventional gland-forming adenocarcinoma architecture, cohesive tumor regions, moderate desmoplastic stromal reaction, limited Crohn-like lymphoid response, less prominent intratumoral lymphocytic infiltration, and invasive tumor borders without dense lymphoid aggregates.

task1: heterogeneous tumor architecture, mucin-rich or serrated-like growth patterns, poorly defined invasive regions, prominent stromal reaction or variable desmoplasia, lymphocyte-rich tumor areas, and Crohn-like lymphoid aggregates near the invasive margin.
task2: irregular infiltrative tumor growth, heterogeneous glandular and solid tumor regions, prominent desmoplastic stromal response, cribriform or complex glandular architecture, mucinous tumor areas, and invasive fronts extending into surrounding tissue.
task3: lymphocyte-rich tumor regions, prominent Crohn-like lymphoid aggregates at the invasive margin, mucinous or medullary-like growth patterns, pushing or expansile tumor borders, heterogeneous tumor architecture, and reduced or variable desmoplastic stromal reaction.

task1: well-formed to moderately formed malignant glands, elongated hyperchromatic nuclei, nuclear stratification, dirty necrosis within glandular lumina, moderate cytologic atypia, limited mucin-rich differentiation, and sparse to moderate tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes.
task2: malignant glandular structures lined by atypical columnar epithelial cells, enlarged hyperchromatic nuclei, nuclear pseudostratification, intraluminal dirty necrosis, moderate glandular differentiation, and limited single-cell invasion or tumor budding.
task3: atypical malignant glands, elongated hyperchromatic nuclei, nuclear stratification, dirty necrosis, moderate cytologic pleomorphism, relatively sparse tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes, and limited direct contact between lymphocytes and tumor epithelial cells.

task1: irregular or poorly formed malignant glands, serrated glandular morphology, extracellular mucin pools, enlarged pleomorphic nuclei, high-grade cytologic atypia, tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes, and frequent interaction between inflammatory cells and tumor epithelial cells.
task2: irregular malignant glands, cribriform or fused glandular structures, enlarged pleomorphic tumor nuclei, increased nuclear atypia, scattered tumor budding, extracellular mucin or necrotic debris, and mixed inflammatory cells surrounding invasive tumor nests.
task3: dense tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes, lymphocytes intermingled with malignant epithelial cells, poorly differentiated or medullary-like tumor areas, mucinous differentiation, enlarged pleomorphic nuclei, conspicuous inflammatory microenvironment, and frequent tumor-immune cell contact.
